delta: # Story 56 — CUSTOMERS-1-WEB: agent — I search customers by name, address or number

(Story: CRM-56)

## Prerequisites

- **`CUSTOMERS-1-API` (CRM-55)** — endpoint `GET /custom
ers` returning `{ items, total, limit, offset }` with the `readPagination` ceiling enforced (BR-4). Must ship first; this story is a p

ure consumer.
- **`PLATFORM-16-WEB` (CRM-31)** — provides `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `Skeleton` under `web/src/shared/ui/`. This is the first real

caller; report any misfit rather than working around it.
- **`LANGUAGES-3-WEB` (CRM-39)** — prov

ides `useFormatters` from `web/src/shared/i18n/`. Any date or number rendering on this screen must go through it.
- **`PLATFORM-*` shell/auth** — `R
equireAuth` (`web/src/app/require-auth.tsx`), `DeskShell` (`web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx`) and the routes table (`web/src/app/routes.tsx`

) are the mount points.
- **Read first:** `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — one rule per prior defect; do not rep

eat any of them.
- Coordination with owner of `CUSTOMERS-1-API` (CRM-55) if the envelope shape or error codes dis

agree with what this screen needs — that is a finding to report, **not** a licence to edit `api/`.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver the
first authenticated **Customers** list screen in `web/`. An agent lands on `/customers`, sees a paginated list backed by the API, and can

search by **name**, **address**, or **number** with:

1. Shared `Skeleton` while loading; the

layout does not jump when results arrive.
2. `EmptyState` (with a next-action affordance) when the query returns zero rows (D-2).

3. `ErrorState` with the documented code's meaning **and** a retry when the API fails.
4. Every visible string s

ourced from **both** `en.ts` and `ar.ts` (BR-6).
5. Paging driven **entirely** by the API envelope (`items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`)

— the screen does not slice, does not re-count, does not invent a page size beyond choosing a `limit` to request (BR-4).

**Not** in scope: any
`api/` change; a customer detail screen; create/edit/delete; internal notes; sorting controls; changes to `useRequest`, the shared state components, or the shell

layout beyond adding one route and one nav item.

Rows are **inert** in this story (no detail screen exists yet — `CUSTOMERS-2-WEB`);

this is stated in the plan and rendered as read-only cells rather than links.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — the only
place a screen expresses loading. Statuses are `idle | loading | success | error`; `success` with an empty `items` array **is** the empty state, not a fourth status. Match

the existing hook signature exactly.
2. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.test.ts` — copy the harness pattern (no real timers, no unst

ubbed fetch) for the new page tests.
3. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and `web/src/shared/api/errors.ts` — call the API through the sh
ared client; surface its error type into `ErrorState`. Grep for `apiFetch` (or the exported symbol) before

naming it in code.
4. `web/src/shared/ui/EmptyState.tsx`, `web/src/shared/ui/ErrorState.tsx`, `web/src/shared/ui/Skeleton
.tsx` and their tests (`states.test.tsx`) — confirm the actual props (message vs children, action vs button, size variants). If the shape does

not fit a real list screen, capture it in **Edge Cases** as a finding.
5. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` — the barrel;

import states through it.
6. `web/src/shared/ui/Stack.tsx`, `Card.tsx`, `Heading.tsx`, `Text.tsx`, `Field.tsx`, `Input.t

sx`, `Button.tsx` — use these for layout and the search input; do not introduce raw `<div>` styling.
7. `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` and

`web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts` — every colour/spacing value must be a token; the test scans all of `web/src` (D-1).
8. `web/src/sh
ared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — add the new keys to **both** in the same commit; `defineLocale` fails the build if one side l

acks a key.
9. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` — fails on empty or copied Arabic values.
10. `web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx` — how `useTranslate` (

or equivalent) is exposed to pages. Grep for the exported hook name before referencing it.
11. `web/src/shared/i18n/useFormatters.ts` and `useFormatters.test.tsx` — the
only accepted path for any date/number rendering on the screen (LANGUAGES-3-WEB, CRM-39). Do **not** call `toLocaleDateString` direct

ly.
12. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` — where the authenticated routes are declared; add the `/customers` entry here, in

side `RequireAuth` and inside `DeskShell`.
13. `web/src/app/require-auth.tsx` — confirm the wrapping pattern; do not duplicate au

th gating.
14. `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx` and `DeskShell.css` and `DeskShell.test.tsx` — the shell renders a single nav item today; adding a second one is the first time nav car

ries more than one entry. Verify it still reads as navigation and update the test to assert two items.
15. `web/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx` — precedent for the smallest authenticated page shape.
16. `web/
src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx` and `SignInPage.test.tsx` — precedent for form input, submit handling, i18n usage and testing patterns without

real timers.
17. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — scans `pages`, `features`, `app`, `shared/ui`. A bare label in the new page fails the suite; every vis

ible string must go through i18n.
18. `web/src/testing/render.tsx` and `setup.ts` — the render helper (i18n, router, auth wiring); use it in

every page test. `setup.ts` refuses unstubbed fetch.
19. `api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js`, `customers.service.js`, `customers.rules.js` — read to confirm the ex
act request shape (`q`, `limit`, `offset`, or whatever the API names them), the ceiling value, and the error codes. Do **not** modify.

20. `api/openapi.json` — canonical envelope and query parameter names for `/customers`.
21. `scripts/criteria/customers.md` — section

`CUSTOMERS-1-WEB` restates the acceptance list; keep the checklist below aligned.
22. `docs/taxonomy.md` and

`docs/architecture.md` — for placement conventions (`pages/customers/`) and naming. Cite, do not restate.

---

## Product rules (from story

)

- **BR-4 — No unbounded list.** Paginated, filterable, sortable, with a maximum page size **enforced by the API**. The screen requests a limit within

the ceiling; it never bypasses paging.
- **BR-6 — Every visible string is a resource key in both languages.** No inline strings, no f

allback to English, no copied Arabic.
- **D-1 — No hardcoded colours.** Tokens only.
- **D-2 — No blank empty regions.** Empty results

render `EmptyState` with copy and a next action.

---

## Implementation tasks

### 1 — Create the Customers page folder

Create files:

- `web/src/pages/customers/Cust

omersPage.tsx`
- `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.css`
- `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx`
- `web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerSearch.ts` (th

in wrapper around `useRequest` + the API client)
- `web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerSearch.test.ts`
- `web/src/pages/customers/index.ts` (re

-export the page component only)

Follow the folder shape of `web/src/pages/sign-in/` — one page component, one CSS file, one test,

colocated hooks with tests.

### 2 — Data fetching hook (`useCustomerSearch.ts`)

Wrap `useRequest` from `web/src/shared/

// exact query name confirmed by reading api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js
  limit: number;    // capped at the API's ceiling; do not exceed it client

etcher; do **not** invent a name).
- Encode `q`, `limit`, `offset` as query params using the exact names the API exp

ects.
- Surface `errors.ts`' error shape as-is to the caller — no rewrapping.
- Return `{ status, data, error, refetch }` as `useRequest` already

does.

### 3 — Search input strategy (decision)

**Decision:** search executes **on submit** (Enter key + explicit "Search" `Button`),

**not** on every keystroke.

**Reason:** the test harness's fetch refuses anything unstubbed, so any debounce would need timer control
the shared setup does not currently offer. Submit-triggered search is defensible, deterministic under vitest, and matches the pattern already

used by `SignInPage`. The typed value is kept in local state; the request is only re-issued when the user submits.

Empty query is allowed and
requests the first page unfiltered (the API is the source of truth about whether `q` is optional; if it

isn't, keep `q` bound to the last submitted value only).

### 4 — `CustomersPage.tsx` composition

Structure (all layout

via `Stack` / `Card`, all typography via `Heading` / `Text`):

1. `Heading` — page title from i18n key `customers.title`.
2. `<form

>` with `Field` + `Input` + `Button` — labels/placeholder/submit copy from i18n.
3. Results region —

one of:
   - `status === 'loading'` → `Skeleton` shaped to the same row footprint the list will occupy (avoid lay

out jump).
   - `status === 'error'` → `ErrorState`, with message keyed off the documented error code (`error.code` → i18n lookup) and a **Retry** action wired to `refetch`.
   - `status ===
'success' && items.length === 0` → `EmptyState`, with copy and a next-action affordance (e.g. clear the query — the story explicitly forbids a

create button, since create is out of scope).
   - `status === 'success' && items.length > 0` → the list, plus paging controls.
4. Paging controls — read `
total`, `limit`, `offset` from the envelope. **Previous** disabled when `offset === 0`; **Next** disabled when `offset + items.length >= total`. Do not
compute a page count for display beyond what the envelope makes trivial (`Math.ceil(total / limit)

`) — and label it via i18n.

Rows are inert (no detail screen yet). Render each row as a `Card` (or a `

<li>` in a token-styled `<ul>`) with:

- customer **number**,
- customer **name**,
- customer **address**,
- any

date field (e.g. `created_at`) **only** through `useFormatters`.

Do **not** wrap rows in a link element.

### 5 — Routing and sh

ell wiring

**File:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Add a `/customers` route inside the existing `RequireAuth` + `DeskShell` composition. Match the ex

act wrapper pattern the home route uses.
- Lazy-import or eager-import consistently with the current file — do not switch sty

les.

**File:** `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx`

- Add a second navigation entry labelled from i18n key `nav.customers`, linking to `/customers`.
- This
is the first time nav carries more than one item. Verify visually and in the test that it still reads as navigation (list semantics, active-route styling if any

any) applies to the current route.

### 6 — i18n keys

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts`

Add, in the existing structure:

- `nav.customers`
- `customers.title`
- `customers

.search.label`
- `customers.search.placeholder`
- `customers.search.submit`
- `customers.empty.title`
- `customers.empty.body`
- `customers.empty.action`
- `customers.error.retry`
- `customers.
error.<code>` — one entry per error code the API documents for this endpoint (read `api/src/features/customers/` and `api/openapi.json` first;

add exactly the codes it can emit, no more).
- `customers.paging.previous`
- `customers.paging.next`
- `customers.paging.summary` — parameterised (e.g. `{start

}–{end} of {total}`).
- Column labels: `customers.column.number`, `customers.column.name`, `customers.column.address`, and any date column used

.

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

- Add every key above with a **real** Arabic translation. Empty or copied-from-English values fail `parity.test.ts`

.

Both files must change in the same commit; `defineLocale` fails on asymmetric keys.

### 7 — Styling

**File:** `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.css`

- Every col

our, radius, spacing, font-size uses a `var(--…)` from `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css`. `tokens.test.ts` scans all of `web/src`.
- Ske

leton row heights match real row heights so results replace skeletons without layout jump (acceptance criterion #2).

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

-
**Empty query, empty result set** — render `EmptyState` with copy that acknowledges "no results" rather than the initial-state copy; the criterion is that

the empty region is never blank (D-2). Enforced in `CustomersPage.tsx` in the `status === 'success' && items.length === 0` branch.
- **Query in fl
ight while a previous request still resolves** — `useRequest` already collapses; do not add a second dedupe. Verify with a

test that a fast second submit does not double-render the list.
- **API returns a limit smaller than requested** — the scre

en must trust the envelope's `limit`, not its own request. Paging math reads from `envelope.limit`.
- **API retur
ns `total` less than `offset`** — treat as empty page; render `EmptyState`, disable both pa

ging buttons.
- **Unicode / RTL text in `q`** — the input must not strip or normalise. Confirmed by r

endering the raw string state; add a test with an Arabic query.
- **Network /
5xx error** — `ErrorState` shows the mapped i18n message for the code (fall back to a generic key **only** if the code is unknown, and log

the unknown code in the console for follow-up); **Retry** calls `refetch`.
- **401 while typing** — au
th expiry is handled by the existing session-expiry flow (`web/src/app/session-expiry.test.tsx`); do not re-impl

ement here. Note the reliance in the plan.
- **The three shared state components turn out not to fit** (e.g. `
EmptyState` lacks an action slot, `ErrorState` lacks a retry slot) — **stop and report as a finding** rather than forking them; that is the wh

ole point of being the first caller.
- **Nav becomes a "list of one" again if the customers route is later removed** —

not our problem to solve, but noted so the test covers the two-item case explicitly.
- **Unknown API query parameter name** — if re

ading `customers.routes.js` reveals `q` is spelled differently (e.g. `search`), use the API's spelling. Do not guess.

---

## Test Plan

Add / mod

ify the following, all under `web/`:

1. **`web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx`** (new) — using `web

/src/testing/render.tsx`:
   1. renders the page title and search field from i18n (both en and ar via language switch).
   2. shows `Skeleton`

while the stubbed fetch is pending.
   3. shows the results list when the envelope has items.
   4. shows `EmptyState` with the "no results" copy when `items` is empty.

5. shows `ErrorState` with the mapped code message and a working Retry that re-issues the request.
   6. submits the search on Enter and on Button click, and does **not** iss

ue a request per keystroke.
   7. paging Next issues a request with `offset += limit`; Previous with `offset -= limit`; both disabled at boundaries.
   8.

an Arabic-language render still passes and reads correctly.
2. **`web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerSearch.test.ts`** (new) — status trans

itions, query encoding (`q`, `limit`, `offset`), envelope pass-through, error pass-through.
3. **`web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.test.tsx`** (modify) — assert **

both** nav items render; active-route styling correct for `/customers`.
4. **`web/src/app/routing.test.tsx`** (modify if it enumerates routes) — assert `/customers` ren

ders `CustomersPage` inside `RequireAuth`, and that an unauthenticated visit redirects to sign-in.
5. **`web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** — no code

change expected; it must still pass. If it flags a string, fix the string, not the test.
6. **`web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.

ts`** — must pass; Arabic entries must be real translations.
7. **`web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts`** — must pass; no raw colours in the new CSS.

All tests use `web

/src/testing/render.tsx`; none use real timers; none call unstubbed fetch (per `setup.ts`).

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd web && npm run d
ev` — visit `/`, sign in, click the new **Customers** nav item, exercise: empty submit → results; nonsense query → empty state with
next action; force an error (temporarily point client at a bad URL) → error state with retry; page next

/previous.
2. **Frontend build:** `cd web && npm run build` — this is the typecheck (`tsc -b && vite build`); a change

vitest saw but tsc did not is not verified.
3. **Frontend tests:** `cd web && npm test` — all new and modified tests green;

`no-hardcoded-strings`, `parity`, `tokens`, `no-mirrored-styles` still green.
4. **Language parity spot-check:** `cd

web && npm test -- parity` — asserts en/ar symmetry for the new keys.
5. **Regression:** run the full `web/` suite once more after

rebasing; ensure `DeskShell.test.tsx` and `routing.test.tsx` still pass.
6. **AI-attribution grep** (must return **no

matches**):
   `git grep -nEi "co-authored-by|generated (with|by) (
chatgpt|claude|copilot|gpt|ai)|assistant|anthropic|openai" -- web/src .squad/plans/custom

ers` — nothing committed may mention AI assistance.
7. **Backend untouched:** `git status api/` shows no

changes; `git diff --stat api/` empty.

---

## Done Criteria

- [ ] `/customers` route exists in

side `RequireAuth` and `DeskShell`; a nav item links to it.
- [ ] Empty search results render `EmptyState` with a next action (D-2).
- [

] Loading renders `Skeleton`; results replace it without layout jump.
- [ ] Failed request renders `ErrorState` with the documented code's me

aning and a working **Retry**.
- [ ] Every string on the screen is sourced from `en.ts` and `ar.ts`; `no-hardcoded-strings` and `parity` tests pass (

BR-6).
- [ ] Paging uses only the API envelope (`items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`); no client-side slicing or invented page size (BR-4).

- [ ] Any date/number rendering goes through `useFormatters`; no direct `toLocaleDateString` calls in the new code.
- [ ] `

cd web && npm run build` and `cd web && npm test` both pass.
- [ ] No `api/` files modified.
- [ ] No commit, comment, doc line, or ignore-

file entry mentions AI assistance (grep in Verification Step 6 clean).
- [ ] `DeskShell`

navigation still reads as navigation with two items (test updated).
- [ ] If any of `EmptyState` / `ErrorState` / `Skeleton` did not fit, the mis

fit is reported in the story write-up rather than worked around.
